breaking.change: HeightmapDesc accepts metre-valued heights up to 4097 samples per side. Cook and runtime reject invalid stage parameters instead of the runtime silently clamping them; terraceSharpness is replaced by terraceBlend (default 0.4), matching terrain.generate.terraces.blend.
breaking.fix: Pass heights with columns/rows to process a designed field, use terraceBlend for terrace smoothing, and supply parameters in the documented terrain generator ranges.

added.summary: Processes an existing PNG/EXR heightmap or a deterministic TS heightfield through the same erosion, thermal, terraces, shore, automatic rivers and biome stages as runtime. Authored metre heights are not implicitly normalised or clipped.

Runs cook's synchronous deterministic TS generator with tracked relative imports, parameters, seed and explicit byte inputs, reusing the cook action cache; also exposed as MCP script. No ambient I/O, clock, process or network.

Adds the file namespace to list/find/show and MCP: every registered type is discoverable with an explicit field-coverage status; terrain's nested parser tables are generated and drift-checked. The generating guide's multi-file OGT/TS recipe runs through real cook and headless execution.
